annotations.title: Jobs that fit a person's experience

description: Current US and Canadian openings ranked by how closely they fit a person's work history: the job titles they have held, years of experience, skills, place and minimum pay. Each title is read as the occupation that most employers' current postings with that title fall under; openings are then ranked by title match, same or neighbouring occupation, skills named in the posting's title and seniority fit (intern and junior roles drop for experienced people, senior roles for people starting out). Each result says why it is listed, with the pay range the employer published or the official median when it published none, and the link to apply on the employer's site. No job descriptions are read, so a skill counts only when the employer put it in the job title. Nothing about the person is stored. Same coverage limits as find_jobs.

include_remote.description: With a place: also include remote jobs (default true).

min_pay.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD. A job stays when its published range reaches it or, with no published pay, when the official median for the job there does.

place.description: A US state (texas or TX), a large US metro area (austin), canada or a Canadian province. Leave out for everywhere.

skills.description: Skills or specialties, twelve at most (ICU, pediatrics, Python).

titles.description: Job titles the person has held, most recent first, three at most (registered nurse, charge nurse).
